In 1. are all FRA points for EDUUFRAN listed and in 2 the additional ones for EDUUFRAE via listed sectors. FRA points in 3 enables additional x-border options via MUAC or  Scandinavia towards Austria (see also EDLO1038) - located mostly in EDUUERL1R.

ATTN: TFR split into 3 sub-parts only for better maintaining data in RAD excel, programming should be done in one combined restriction.
annex2b_rules.remarks:
ATTN
AMDs of points might require prior coordination with adjacent ANSPs.

1. Traffic exiting Maastricht UAC via DELOM shall proceed southbound via the Nicky sector. It is required to plan via DENOX - SISGA - DELOM. When EBTRASBZ is not active, more efficient route options via NILEM are available.
2. Traffic via DELOM shall not plan via the Koksy sector of Maastricht UAC. Suggested intermediate waypoint is WOODY to avoid clipping of the sector.
3. Traffic via DELOM shall not plan via the Hannover sectors of Maastricht UAC sector. Suggested intermediate waypoint for traffic above FL315 is EMMUN to avoid clipping of the sector. Traffic below FL315 needs to plan further to the West via intermediate waypoints PIPQU / NIGUG / GISEB.
4. Traffic via the Olno or Luxembourg sector of Maastricht UAC shall file via RASCA / KUDIN / TOLVU.

annex2b_rules.operational_goal:
To limit the alternative route option ARR EDDB via NOMKA.  NOMKA shall only be used by flights which originally intend to plan via BATEL but are subject to traffic regulations in Bremen ACC. Flights departing from aerodromes in Belgium, Luxembourg, France or even further from the southwest shall file via MUAC Brussels sectors (via LIMGO, BITBU, MATUG, OGLOR) and then EDUU Central sectors (via MASEK).
------
To avoid crossing the Ruhr sector of Maastricht UAC. Traffic departing from an aerodrome within EG** or EI** and entering Maastricht UAC via REDFA shall file via TACHA - SONEB. Traffic entering via LAMSO or further north can plan directyl towards NOMKA.

annex2b_rules.operational_goal:
1. Dublin group/EINC arrivals shall route VATRY/LIPGO/NIRIF. EINN/KY arrivals shall route SLANY. EICK/WF arrivals shall route ENJEX.
2. To prevent complexity due crossover of traffic.  BAKUR is mainly for tfc to OEP NEBIN, or to DOGAL by traffic listed in 2.d. 2.b. When listed areas are active tfc to ETARI/PIKIL/RESNO/VENER may also file BAKUR but traffic via NEBIN must then file via SLANY to avoid increased complexity at BAKUR. 
3. To ensure correct FPD/routeings.
4. To separate flows. This traffic shall file FELCA NICXI.
5. Traffic inbound to listed airfields shall file VATRY/LIPGO unless one or more of the listed areas are active at the filed FL.
6. This traffic shall file ENJEX.
7. To deconflict against northbound traffic via NIRIF.  If any of the listed areas are notified active FL145+ this tfc shall file RUKOH instead of BAKUR.
8. EINN/KY/WF deps shall file ENJEX. EICK deps shall file BANBA/EVRIN.
9. BAKUR eastbound is for Dublin Group/EINC deps or UK overflights/EGJ* arrivals.

annex2b_rules.operational_goal:
To force traffic arriving EPWA/EPMO on mandatory arrival routings
Traffic arriving to EPWA/EPMO via LOGDA should use one of the following options:
1) KOTEK M866 LOGDA
2) ORTEB DCT KONZI DCT LOGDA (available only above FL285 in POLFRA)

Traffic arriving EPWA/EPMO Shall be planned as follow:
-  via intermediate point ORTEB - flights with cruising level above FL285
-  EP departures from aerodroms located below TMA Krakow and  eng-type Turboprop, Piston, dep. LKMT, dep. LKTB via NETIR shall use shorter connection via point KOTEK using route network in TMA Krakow (EPKK)
-  DEP LHBP with RFL below 285 should plan via KOTEK.
- additionally, until AIRAC NOV 2021 EPWA/EPMO arrivals via NETIR are also avaialble to plan via KOTEK

annex2b_rules.operational_goal:
1&7. Force traffic into the LSAGUAC sector. Prevent fast traffic avoiding regulation in LSAGUAC by flying in the lower airspace and to keep that traffic out of LSAGN sector
2. Ensure high performance traffic departing from LSGS avoids LSAGN. Traffic using SAPRE SID or joining at SAPRE should file FL245+ at SAPRE
3. Prevent indirect routing via LFSBBM - LSAGN - LFEE5EH discourage this sequence to reduce unnecessary load on LSAGN
4&8.Force traffic via a specific route. Enforce structured routing to avoid route dispersion and maintain network efficiency
5. Prevent traffic filing from Basel or Reims area (eg LFSB) heading south to the Geneva area an then north again to the Paris area or ARR LFGJ LFLH LFGI LFSD
6. Block-non standard routings via LSAGN below FL245 Prevent low-level entries into LSAGN. Traffic from north via should not file below FL245 until GEVEA
9. To avoid low level filing through LSAG Lower sectors for mentioned DEP AD.

annex2b_rules.operational_goal:
To create structural limitations to segregate climbing and descending traffic from overflights.
a. GILIR DCT NINTU a direct option for overflights.
b. GILIR DCT TUROM (and then MILPA) is only available for Basel group departures and provides lateral spacing from overflights to facilitate climb.
c. GILIR DCT GEVEA to segregate overflights from the climbing/descending traffic via TUROM and MILPA.
d. GILIR DCT MILPA is only available for traffic arriving LFLU/MH to provide lateral spacing for the descent and to provide a connection for State flights that must avoid Swiss territory.
5. To allow for GILIR to be used as an exit point

When LST21, LST22, LST201, LST202 are not active, overflights should plan IRMAR DCT KINES DCT VANAS DCT ESOKO DCT GODRA.
Descending traffic to the mention aerodromes should plan IRMAR DCT VANAS DCT MOBLO.

Traffic orientation. 
1. Traffic to destination EHAM, EHRD shall not plan via BLUFA if coming from the South or West. Traffic via BLUFA shall generally come from North to East.

The route extension via EEL / KUBAT will ensure that the profile can be achieved.
3, 4, 5, 6, 7. Traffic orientation during military training area activity. Reference location for the dependent time applicability is BLUFA.
8. To avoid that flights are filing above an active military area when its upper limit, promulgated in the EAUP/EUUP, is lower than the standard value. During military activity, these flights shall plan a lateral re-routing; e.g. via ONTAZ.

annex2b_rules.operational_goal:

annex2b_rules.operational_goal: To avoid that flights are filing above an active military area when its upper limit, promulgated in the EAUP/EUUP, is lower than the standard value. Due to a dynamic LoA condition, the specified arrival aerodromes may be cleared tactically to descend early in order to cross LONAM at or below FL330. Therefore, it is not possible for ATC to facilitate the descent profile which satisfy the dynamic LoA condition but would not infringe the military training areas when these are activated above FL325.

1. To facilitate correct flight data processing. Specified traffic shall route via NIK, BUB or REMBA before NILEM.
2. Traffic via the Luxembourg sectors of Maastricht UAC shall file via RASCA / KUDIN / TOLVU.
3. Traffic via NILEM shall not plan via the Koksy sector of Maastricht UAC. Suggested intermediate waypoint is WOODY to avoid clipping of the sector.

5. Traffic via NILEM shall not plan via the Hannover sectors of Maastricht UAC sector. Suggested intermediate waypoint for traffic above FL315 is EMMUN to avoid clipping of the sector. Traffic below FL315 needs to plan further to the West via intermediate waypoints PIPQU / NIGUG / GISEB.

annex2b_rules.operational_goal:
ATC flight data processing system requirement. Traffic to destination EDFX / EDXW can only plan via waypoints PIXUR, UGLOM, DIRBO, SUQIF if the route also contains waypoint EXNEL. This combination of waypoints triggers a special FPL treatment in ATC systems that is required when military training areas EDR201D / EDR201E are active. Since the ATC system does not have information on the MTA status, the special treatment is applied at all times which is unnecessary and inefficient when the MTAs are not active. 
When EDR201D / EDR201E are not active, there are other and more efficient route options available via MUAC FRA which bypass PIXUR, UGLOM, DIRBO, SUQIF. Recommended routes avoiding the three points are:
1) BASUM DCT ABFAD DCT OLDIP
2) (ELNAT, TOLGI) DCT ELSOB Y348 OMWEG DCT BADOS DCT OLDIP
3) ABGUS DCT ELSOB Y348 OMWEG DCT BADOS DCT OLDIP
4) SOMVA DCT MAVAS DCT ANDIK N873 HUNQI DCT ROCZO and then OLDIP
5) ADUTO N873 VICOT DCT JUIST HUNQI DCT ROCZO and then OLDIP

annex2c_fua.operational_goal:
It shall enable the more flexible use of this area (short haul flights will benefit more then long haul). 
In principle flights departing from locations more than four hours flying time away should not be allowed to flight plan via the potentially used area. Nevertheless in the hours until noon more flights (up to 12 h flying time) and at late evening some more flights (up to around 6h flying time) can be excluded from this general restriction due to timely sufficient process of UUP publication and activation of this FUA restriction.
The objective is to minimize tactical re-routing of those flights since they can not consider the eUUP during the flight planning stage but are usually already airborne. We expect more FPLs using the option via EDR305 when inactive.
